name: Stordiag.exe
author: Eral4m

commands.description: Once executed, Stordiag.exe will execute schtasks.exe systeminfo.exe and fltmc.exe - if stordiag.exe is copied to a folder and an arbitrary executable is renamed to one of these names, stordiag.exe will execute it.

Once executed, Stordiag.exe will execute schtasks.exe and powershell.exe - if stordiag.exe is copied to a folder and an arbitrary executable is renamed to one of these names, stordiag.exe will execute it.

detection: systeminfo.exe, fltmc.exe or schtasks.exe or powershell.exe being executed outside of their normal path of c:\windows\system32\ or c:\windows\syswow64\
